true_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 五策略比较与spanfixture，但目标是独立证据保留非固定胜者；本次读所有source后分析。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 块边界影响候选证据，父块/邻接扩展有时可修复，不是anycut绝对无法修复；LongRAG35个百分点未查来源，不保性能。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 五chunker→统一hashindex→spanhit，实际eval先知道正确doc，各策略未统一token/candidate成本。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Fixed-window
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 字符size与overlap严格参数，unicodecodepoint非bytes/token；overlap可保跨界但仍需完整span/语境。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Sentence
true_h2_h4.中文解释: regex .!?后空白且下个大写/数字分句，中文/缩写/小写/代码不可靠；长句可超budget。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Recursive split
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 按paragraph/newline/.space/space递归，separators耗尽仍整串返回，无最终char切；正文说直到fit不符合。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Semantic clustering
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 逐句mockhash向量cos阈值或maxchars切，centroid计数先+1再加权多1且normalizedmovingavg非真mean。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Structural markdown headers
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 每一个H1–H6都切，不是到same/higher；首header前丢失，fencedcode假header会切，headeronly没过滤。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### How recall@k measures the boundary choice
true_h2_h4.中文解释: source任何1字符overlap即hit均query，是spanHit@K不是完整答案coverage；只正确doc内部检索。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: Chunk doc/strategy/start/end/text，5alg、hashdense、9queryeval打印；没有实际学习dense/embedding模型。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Failure modes the table will not hide
true_h2_h4.中文解释: orphan/code/headeronly/drift/embeddingrevision是有效风险，本实现多个未防；语义cap对单longsentence/空白计数不硬。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Choosing a default without running the benchmark
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 800/500/.6与recursive最强只是经验候选，独立valid/证据长度/预算评后定，不是当前普适default。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 重测模型或corpusmix、保存strategy/config/revision、原文offset与transform范围，使用失效触发不是改date即核。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Ship It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 69只复制recursive子集，68不同docretrievalqrels，不能称完全同metric shape可比。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Exercises
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 实际4练习而非5：token窗口/code注入/真embedding/summary；全部未执行。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Key Terms
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 源Recall是任一span交集命中率，overlap与structural/semantic/centroid用途分别明示。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Further Reading
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 论文和网站只是获取入口，35个百分点/current生产recommendations未核，真实接口不用旧源名代替。

quiz.question: Why is the chunking choice an upper bound on retrieval quality and not just a hyperparameter?
quiz.source_answer: Because no embedding, reranker, or LLM downstream can recover an answer span that was cut into incoherent pieces
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确2边界过度；保完整独立证据重要，但邻接/parentexpand可挽回碎片，并非任何切块不可修。

quiz.question: Which strategy is the strongest single-strategy default when you have no prior knowledge of the corpus?
quiz.source_answer: Recursive split
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确2作为baseline候选，source无独立泛化实验支撑strongestdefault。

quiz.question: What does recall@k measure in this lesson?
quiz.source_answer: Whether any of the top-k chunks overlaps the gold answer span
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；本代码hit任何overlap且知道golddoc，不是全库检索Recall或完整可回答证据。

quiz.question: Why does fixed-window chunking fail badly on code or YAML corpora?
quiz.source_answer: It cuts identifiers and key-value pairs in half, producing chunks that embed to noise
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0；mididentifier断裂风险不是必定hashnoise，AST/完整键值/代码块范围更适用。

quiz.question: What is the centroid drift termination criterion in semantic chunking?
quiz.source_answer: Cosine similarity between the running mean vector and the next sentence drops below a threshold
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0；还受maxchars切，具体sourcecentroidweight有bug，无真语义模型。

quiz.question: What stale-embedding failure mode does semantic chunking introduce that the other four strategies do not?
quiz.source_answer: Chunk boundaries change whenever you change the chunk-model, requiring a coordinated rebuild
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；pin chunkmodel/threshold/strategy和corpusrevision，协调重建chunkIDs/source mapping/index；无需自动迁移已有原文。

practice.中文解释及验收边界: tokenizer固定型号revision、codepoint/tokenoffset映射，窗口必须能定位原文/解码边界；同tokenbudget比较char，tiktoken未安装/调用。

practice.中文解释及验收边界: 30%code比例定义字符/doc/块单位，保持goldspan与结构有效；fence-aware parser/AST与其余baseline对照，不预定只有structural胜，当前structural还会误切codeheader。

practice.source: Replace the deterministic embedding with the one from your project's real provider. Measure the semantic-clustering recall delta. Report whether the spread between strategies widens or narrows.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: 真实provider另授权，本任务未调用；固定modelrevision/normalization、原数据切分、boundarythreshold；测fullspan/candidateRecall/cost而非oracle正确doc内1char。

practice.中文解释及验收边界: summary区分source原文与AI导出，summary支持必须核原chunk；append影响length/score，比较相同budget并以原文span为引用，防答案泄漏/编造事实。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.中文解释: BM25、hash-vector与weightedRRF机械可学；源fieldweight重复非BM25F，RRF胜所有queryclass不成立。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
true_h2_h4.中文解释: literal/改写分布可能不同，真实语义encoder需验证；本hash由字符相似非语义同义词训练，microseconds非实测。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 两ranklist→rankfusion→topK，按稳定identity合并，不直接线性混rawscores。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### BM25 in one paragraph
true_h2_h4.中文解释: idf log(1+(N−df+.5)/(df+.5))、TF饱和f(k1+1)/(f+k1(1−b+b dl/avgdl))；title重复同时变tf/dl/avgdl，不是单纯乘最终score/真每fieldnorm。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Dense retrieval in one paragraph
true_h2_h4.中文解释: normalized96hash+tokenbigram mockembed，每query全量cos排序；跟64无bigram版本不同，不能称字节同模型。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Reciprocal rank fusion, the published formula
true_h2_h4.中文解释: RRF sum_list w/(c+rank1based)，缺list贡献0，c60是一候选，same-list duplicate必须先去。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Why fusion beats score-weighted interpolation
true_h2_h4.中文解释: RRF减少原score标度问题但参数/weights仍须评；已校准scorefusion可有效，allTRECsince2010/universalbeats未经核不保。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: Doc、BM25add/search(positiveonly)、Denseflat、weightedRRF、Hybrid三listtrace及7docdemo，串行非并行。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Tuning the knobs
true_h2_h4.中文解释: k1/b/c/weights在独立valid调，同候选K与输出K；不以literal/dense标签决定无证据最优。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Failure modes the demo will hide
true_h2_h4.中文解释: unknown BM25空但dense仍forcedneighbors且RRF仍给分，dedupdoc不会自动解决unknown；stopword/duplicatecontent/zeroembedding需合同。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: no ANN此码全量sort，HNSW不是一概强制；两路parallel只是建议，RRFhash累加+sort O(M+UlogU)非constanttime。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Ship It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 66消费fusedcandidate但课间代码复制形状，68pseudo不可称full真实pipelinereuse；69实际静读接线。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Exercises
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 实际4练习：真embedding、summary第三路、c sweep、BM25F；不模板补第五。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Key Terms
true_h2_h4.中文解释: k1TF、b长度、rankc与retrievalK不混；title重复是实现trick非BM25F。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Further Reading
true_h2_h4.中文解释: RRF/BM25论文引用待核；Vespa/Weaviate具体默认和API不能借旧源概括当当前规范。

quiz.question: Why does a production RAG endpoint need both lexical and semantic retrieval at once?
quiz.source_answer: The query distribution mixes literal-identifier and paraphrased queries; one modality fails on each class
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3是常见动机，二者实际是否互补取决data/model，端点非必须每次两路。

quiz.question: What is the BM25 parameter b at the default 0.75?
quiz.source_answer: A length-normalization knob: longer documents are penalized but not linearly
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；b0无lengthnorm，b1full；doclength影响TF分母，.75是源默认非唯一published最优。

quiz.question: What does Reciprocal Rank Fusion compute for each candidate?
quiz.source_answer: Sum of 1 / (k + rank) across each ranked list that contains the candidate
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；rank从1起用c+rank，不用rawscore；weighted版乘w，candidate每list一次。

quiz.question: Why is rank-based fusion preferred over a linear interpolation of BM25 and cosine scores?
quiz.source_answer: BM25 scores are unbounded and corpus-dependent; cosine is bounded in -1 to 1; the score scales are not comparable across corpora
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；标度不兼容需校准，RRF非无条件优于scoreinterpolation。

quiz.question: What happens to RRF when you make the constant k very small?
quiz.source_answer: The top-1 contribution dominates the fusion; deep ranks contribute almost nothing
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；c变小rank比更陡，deep贡献相对更小不是严格全为0。

quiz.question: Which failure mode does field weighting through token repetition specifically avoid?
quiz.source_answer: Adding a second score-aggregation step at query time; the math stays identical and per-field-score combination logic is not needed
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0；重复fieldtoken免另scoreaggregation但变tf与doclength，非真正BM25F，titleboost效果需正确反例。

quiz.question: What is the architectural difference between a bi-encoder and a cross-encoder?
quiz.source_answer: A bi-encoder embeds query and document independently; a cross-encoder reads the concatenated (query, document) sequence with full attention across both
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0；联合token序列的self-attention跨query/doc，不是必用另一CrossAttentionmodule。

quiz.question: Why can a cross-encoder not be used as the primary retriever on a 10M-document corpus?
quiz.source_answer: It requires one forward pass per (query, document) pair, which is 10M passes per query
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；需10M pairwork，但可batch所以并非必须10M独立forward调用，代价随paircount/L²与模型。

quiz.question: What is the role of the N parameter in a two-stage retrieve-then-rerank pipeline?
quiz.source_answer: It is the number of candidates returned by the bi-encoder for the cross-encoder to rescore
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；N候选上限影响覆盖与成本，批数受batchsize；rerank后的集合可选K，不超原candidatecoverage。

quiz.question: Why must you pick N strictly larger than K (typically 3x or more)?
quiz.source_answer: If N equals K the cross-encoder cannot reorder, only reweight; rerank lift collapses to zero
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3错误：N=K仍按新score重排，goldrank4→1可提高RR/Hit1；onlysetRecall@K保持。3×K是预算候选不是必要条件。

quiz.question: What does the cross-encoder's mean-pooling head do in this lesson?
quiz.source_answer: Averages the last-layer outputs over non-pad positions and feeds a single linear head to produce one relevance scalar
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确2；nonPAD最后states平均再linear标量，CLS/SEP也属于非PAD，MSEscore不是概率。

quiz.question: Which production failure mode does logging the rank-1 cross-encoder score help detect?
quiz.source_answer: Out-of-domain queries: when the top-1 reranker score is below a corpus-specific threshold, the model is signalling that nothing in the corpus actually answers the query
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0需校正为线索：rawscore低不证无answer；有independentunknownlabels校准后才拒答，domainshift/shorttext/trunc可低score。

quiz.question: What is the core mechanism of HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings)?
quiz.source_answer: Generate a fake answer with an LLM, embed that hypothetical document, and retrieve against its vector instead of the query vector
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；原HyDE对hyp embedding查真实docs，本实现另保originalhybrid并融合，不是纯替换。

quiz.question: Why is it acceptable for the LLM-generated hypothetical document in HyDE to be factually wrong?
quiz.source_answer: The retriever cares about the token distribution, not factual correctness; the hypothetical's vector lands near the real passage
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确2不等错误无害：hyp不是真值，但错entity/事实可拉向错doc；必须只以检索真实docs作回答证据，不保证近正确区域。

quiz.question: What is the difference between multi-query expansion and query decomposition?
quiz.source_answer: Multi-query produces N paraphrases of the same question; decomposition produces sub-questions that together cover a multi-topic question
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0；MQ同意图，DC不同facet共同满足问题，不能把每facet任一doc hit算整体覆盖。

quiz.question: When does query decomposition over-split and hurt retrieval?
quiz.source_answer: When the query is atomic (single-topic), the decomposer invents fake sub-questions and the retrievals all return the same document with reduced rank
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确2；atomic误拆可能漂移/稀释，不是必然每次降低；需保约束与负对照。

quiz.question: Why do the three rewriting strategies fuse with RRF rather than score interpolation?
quiz.source_answer: Score interpolation requires per-corpus calibration; RRF combines rank-based contributions without calibration, which is required when fusing N retrievals from different rewrites
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0；RRF免scores同标度需求，但k/weights/candidatebudget仍需选择，校准scorefusion并非非法。

quiz.question: What is the latency floor when running all three rewriters in parallel?
quiz.source_answer: One LLM call (the rewriters and retrievals run in parallel; the LLM call is the floor)
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确2只是理想并行下LLM阶段约最大call延迟，端到端还要后依赖retrieval+merge；源码串行mock无LLM latency实证。

quiz.question: Why is recall@k usually the headline retrieval metric in production RAG?
quiz.source_answer: Generation can drop irrelevant chunks but cannot invent an answer from a chunk it never saw, so missing the right chunk is the more expensive failure
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；candidate miss不能靠rerank恢复，但过多无关有毒/分散/上下文budget风险，非rarelypoison保证。

quiz.question: What does MRR compute?
quiz.source_answer: The mean of 1 / position-of-first-relevant-document across queries
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；rank1→1/rank2→.5/没找到0，query平均；topK截断则报告MRR@K。

quiz.question: When should you reach for nDCG instead of recall@k?
quiz.source_answer: When the gold labels carry graded relevance (e.g. doc A is 3, doc B is 2, doc C is 1) and binary metrics lose information
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；gradedgain/positiondiscount，不取代binary相关coverage，均可同报。

quiz.question: What is the difference between faithfulness and answer relevance?
quiz.source_answer: Faithfulness asks 'is the answer grounded in the retrieved context'; answer relevance asks 'does the answer address the question'
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；contextsupport与回答question是独立轴，支持不等来源真值。

quiz.question: A pipeline shows decent recall@5 but low MRR. Which stage should you investigate first?
quiz.source_answer: The reranker, because the right chunk is in the top-k but not at the top
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；先检查排序/候选含gold与budget，但还需gold标签/多facet和duplicateID，不必然只reranker。

quiz.question: What production hazard makes a frozen qrels file dangerous over time?
quiz.source_answer: Qrels rot: the corpus changes and a doc that was the gold answer last quarter is no longer the right answer; metrics get reported against stale labels
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；corpusrevision/删除/事实变化触发qrels重标，quarterly只是治理选择非通用期限。

practice.source: Add a fifth retrieval metric: hit-rate@k. Compare it against recall@k. Explain when they differ.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: Hit@k每query只问任一正确，Recall@k问相关集合比例；gold3取到1则Hit1、Recall1/3，同singlegold二者等价。

practice.source: Implement a graded faithfulness: 0 (unsupported), 1 (partially supported), 2 (fully supported). Update the metric accordingly.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: claims部分support可0/1/2后除2N，需标注什么是部分/拒断和interannotatoragreement；数值错误/限定词不能按词重叠平均搪塞。

practice.source: Replace the mock judge with a real model call. Measure the disagreement between the mock and the real judge on the fixture.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: 真实judge另授权，本任务未调用；拿人工标注样本比较precision/recall/误判类型、LLM间disagreement而非把realjudge作绝对truth。

practice.source: Add a query-class slice ("literal", "paraphrased", "multi-topic"). Report per-slice metrics.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: literal/paraphrase/multifacet标签独立定义、分母/样本数/CI和每querytrace；多facet必须全部证据coverage，不只单doc命中。

practice.source: Add an "answer length" metric and correlate it with faithfulness. Plot the curve.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: 长度按token/claim定义，分层控制题难/证据量；关联不证长答导致幻觉，空答/拒答单独算。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Learning Objectives
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 组合各stage及引用/拒答/固定eval/退出码；只有实际检查到的局部mock可成立，不能从fixture满足阈值说systemship。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## The Problem
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 组件交互确需integration，但stage tests仍有意义；同toyqrels端到端不是唯一/充分productiongrade。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## The Concept
true_h2_h4.中文解释: Source→recursivechunks→hybridindex；queryheuristicrewrite→retrieve→trueCE+lexical→extractivegen→5proxycriteria→exit。不直接import64–68而复制缩减实现。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Wiring choices
true_h2_h4.中文解释: Chunk只有doc_id,index,text；Pipeline5默认对象可替同接口而generator是全局函数无inject参数。无ACL/revision/offset身份，只query stage timer。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### Answer generator with citations
true_h2_h4.中文解释: rankedtop1 blended rawscore阈值.05；top3按querycontent重叠选2或fallback第一，复制首句加anchor。score过阈但零重叠仍答，不是nooverlap拒答。引用存在不证满足问/当前有效事实。

true_h2_h4.heading: ### The self-terminating demo
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 4evalquery五指标THRESHOLDSgate，run_demo返0/1再sys.exit，属程序真实行为意图；无本次运行，不报告实际pass。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Build It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: Chunker只recursive，hash dense/bm25/RRF、heuristicrewriter、真实torchCE、extractivegenerator、Resulttrace及小eval；不完整复现6课全部variant/metric。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Failure modes the demo will hide
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 训练query字面不同但相同doc/facts/人工hardneg；改写table逐字含eval答案；selector却四eval都multiquery不触发HyDE。复制文本仍可错相关/宏观答义/错误source，nohallucination绝对说法过宽。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Use It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: CIgate需独立切分/锁版本/失败trace；20query30s/nightly示例不是SLA保证。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Ship It
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 实现缺ingest发布/身份/ACL/update/serving/streaming/tokenbudget；retrieverhash不是真实dense，eval支持只是tokenproxy，不能称 productioncomplete。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Exercises
true_h2_h4.中文解释: 5练习如selector现已实现heuristics，应强化保语义/测selection，不重复说缺功能。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Key Terms
true_h2_h4.中文解释: pipeline/anchor/refusal/smoke/interface是组合、定位、决策、子集和类型；anchor没有revision无法长期唯一定位。

true_h2_h4.heading: ## Further Reading
true_h2_h4.中文解释: URLs为入口未本轮核，无实际服务/部署或LLM调用。

quiz.question: Why is the integration test the only honest grade of a six-component RAG pipeline?
quiz.source_answer: Each stage's isolated metric does not predict the system's metric because each stage interacts with the next; the only valid grade is the whole pipeline run end to end against the same qrels
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3过度称only：integration看组合必要，局部stage也合法；生产能力需独立真实test/ACL/sourcecorrectness等。

quiz.question: What is the role of refuse-on-low-confidence in the answer generator?
quiz.source_answer: It returns 'I do not know' when the reranker top-1 score sits below a corpus-specific threshold, preventing hallucinated answers when the retrieved context does not address the query
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；低score可以拒答，但MSE+lexical非confidence概率，未校准不能说模型告诉无答案或preventhallucinations。

quiz.question: Why are the rerank training triples kept disjoint from the eval queries?
quiz.source_answer: To prevent train-test leakage; if the eval queries overlap the rerank training set the eval looks magical and the regression test does not catch real drift
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确0原则；本17triple字面不含4evalquestion却同facts/docs/near paraphrase，不能称独立场景泛化。

quiz.question: What is the purpose of the self-terminating demo's exit code?
quiz.source_answer: It encodes pass/fail against the metric thresholds; a CI smoke test can plug the demo into the pipeline and gate the merge on a non-zero exit
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确3；exitcode接阈值PASSFAIL；本次没有运行不能写实际0/pass。

quiz.question: What does a citation anchor look like in this pipeline?
quiz.source_answer: [doc_id:chunk_index]
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；anchor[doc:index]只字符串定位意图，缺revision/offset/可信resolver，需校验真实支持非仅出现。

quiz.question: Which failure mode is invisible to the mock generator and must be tested with a real LLM before shipping?
quiz.source_answer: Hallucination: the mock generator only emits text from retrieved chunks and cannot invent content; a real LLM can ignore the chunks and generate ungrounded answers
quiz.中文解释及核对: 源正确1；mock只copy却仍可能答错facet/无关/错source或误引用，复制不等免hallucination和正确；真实LLM另需评估，latency也同样mock不覆盖。

practice.source: Add a per-query strategy selector inside the rewriter: heuristics from lesson 67 (length, conjunctions, jargon ratio) pick HyDE, multi-query, or decomposition.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: 源码pick_strategy已and→decompose/jargon→HyDE/defaultMQ，没length/jargonratio/学selector；设计valid上策略收益/成本与意图保留，unknown不强改，避免table答案污染。

practice.source: Add a real LLM call for the generator behind an env flag. Default to the mock. Measure the latency delta.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: 真实LLM behindenv需独立授权，本任务不执行；替换后检查逐claim支持/禁止以hyp作证据、emptycontext未知、promptinjection/引用resolver与真实latency。

practice.source: Extend the demo to take a `--corpus path` flag that loads a real corpus. Re-run the eval and the threshold check.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: 新corpus须revision/许可/ACL、标准doc/chunkID/offset、增量重建/duplicatehandling和新标qrels；fixture阈值不可直接复制真实资料。

practice.source: Add a `--strategy` flag to the chunker. Measure each strategy's contribution to end-to-end recall.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: chunkflag保持同sourcecover与goldspan映射，递归硬cap/字节token/位置/citationrevision；候选budget固定，对比可完整回答coverage非仅docid命中。

practice.source: Add a streaming generator interface and feed it into the eval. Confirm that faithfulness is computed on the final string and not on the streamed prefix.
practice.中文解释及验收边界: stream接口应区分prefix/已确认claim/terminal，取消/旧epoch抛弃；终态答案再eval，前缀真度只独立metric，不能结束前宣告最终faithful。
